newsitem.title: USA: TRO Learning closes private debt placement.
newsitem.headline: TRO Learning closes private debt placement.

text.p: TRO Learning Inc said Monday it completed a $3 million private placement of subordinated convertible debentures.
The company said it also recently expanded its existing credit facility to $21 million from $12.5 million that provides a maximum line of credit of $18 million and an additional $3 million term loan.
TRO Learning, a provider of training and educational services, said the money from the debt placement and the revamped credit facility will be used to support its long-term growth objectives.
Its shares were off 1/32 Monday at 7-7/8.
